description: This file defines functions and constants related to Discord channel actions, including message tool description, action extraction, and handling, as well as runtime loading and account resolution.

methods.name: loadDiscordChannelActionsRuntime
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the Discord channel actions runtime module.

methods.name: resolveDiscordActionDiscovery
methods.description: Creates a gate to determine if Discord actions are enabled based on account tokens.

methods.name: resolveScopedDiscordActionDiscovery
methods.description: Resolves whether specific Discord actions are enabled for a given account ID.

methods.name: describeDiscordMessageTool
methods.description: Generates a description of available Discord message actions based on discovery.
